title: rmb-desktop bug list
description: Machine-readable bug track, mirror of feature_list.json. State machine: reported → investigating → diagnosed → fixing → passing. Transitions are gated by scripts/verify-bug.sh (make bug-state / make verify-bug); state=passing is never set by hand. Full workflow: AGENTS.md 'Bug workflow'.

id.description: Internal id; branch fix/<id>-<slug>, doc docs/bugs/<id>-investigation.md. The GitHub issue number is the external id (field: issue).

title.description: Issue title verbatim: bug(<scope>): <symptom>, or flaky: <TestName> <behavior>

module.description: Owning package path, e.g. internal/hook (scope↔module map in AGENTS.md)

investigation.description: Path to the phase-2 investigation doc (normally docs/bugs/<id>-investigation.md)

branch.description: fix/<id>-<slug>; created in phase 2, continued in phase 3 — one branch per bug

evidence.description: Written only by make verify-bug: commit + date; append 'issue closed' after merge

layers.description: L1 static / L2 runtime (the phase-2 regression test, now expected to pass) / L3 system (make check)

file.description: Test file containing the failing test, tagged with a '// B<nn>' comment

cmd.description: Command that runs it, e.g. go test ./internal/hook -run TestZcodeUserPromptCaptured

repair.description: What to do when this layer fails (printed by verify-bug.sh)
